newsitem.title: USA: New York murderer says he is now "Son of Hope".
newsitem.headline: New York murderer says he is now "Son of Hope".

text.p: Twenty years after murdering six people and terrorising New York as the Son of Sam, David Berkowitz says he has become a born-again Christian and the "Son of Hope," the New York Daily News reported Sunday.
His comments came in a letter written to the newspaper.

Berkowitz shot couples and young women on the street and in parked cars in eight incidents between June 1976 and June 1977, wounding eight people as well as killing six. At the scene of one shooting, he left a letter saying: "I am a monster. I am the Son of Sam."
He pleaded guilty to the crimes, said he was taking instructions from a neighbour's dog and received six consecutive sentences of 25 years to life.

In his new letter, directed to a specific but undisclosed writer at the News, Berkowitz said, "I truly deserve punishment and death." He said he prayed for his victims and their families and was "sure that their suffering will continue for many years to come."
He wrote that he had little recollection of his crimes. "Sir, please understand that the past is too painful for me to dwell on," he said.
The News said Berkowitz worked for 21 cents an hour as a clerk/typist for Chaplain Services at Sullivan Correctional Facility in upstate Fallsburg, New York.
The paper treated the letter as a news story and did not run it in its entirety or disclose its length or date.
